$comment: The canonical Free/Pro map. This file is the single source of truth and is
loaded by BOTH test suites — test/unit/feature_gate_test.dart and
webapp/src/lib/entitlement/gates.test.ts — so the two clients cannot drift
into disagreeing about what money buys. Same anti-drift pattern as
test/fixtures/health_cases.json.
The principle: free is your whole present; Pro is depth, history,
automation and output. Nothing you have already entered is ever hidden
from you, and nothing that gets your data OUT is ever gated.
principle: Free is your whole present. Pro is depth, history, automation and output.

$comment: Features that must NEVER be gated, in any tier, forever. The test suites
assert this as a hard invariant rather than trusting a comment — see the
negative half of feature_gate_test.dart. If a future change tries to put
any of these behind a payment, the build fails.

reasons.backupExport: Never hold a user's own data hostage.
reasons.backupRestore: An export you cannot restore is not a backup. Gating restore would make the free tier a data trap.
reasons.csvDumpAll: Leaving must always be possible, in a format that needs no Khazana to read.
reasons.eraseAllData: Deleting your own data is not a feature to sell.
reasons.errorLogExport: This is our only support channel; charging for it would mean charging to report our own bugs.
reasons.pinLock: Security is never an upsell. Apple review dislikes it and it is wrong in a vault product.
reasons.ghostMode: Same — hiding your balances is a safety feature, not a luxury.
reasons.themes: Gating cosmetics for the price of Pro makes the app feel stingy and buys nothing.
reasons.diagnostics: It reports data-integrity problems including records that will not decrypt. Hiding that behind a paywall is indefensible.
reasons.reminders: Local notifications cost us nothing and a missed bill costs the user real money.
reasons.manualEntry: The ledger itself. See noCaps below.
reasons.manualPriceEntry: So a free portfolio is still CORRECT, just not auto-refreshed.

$comment: There are NO count limits on the ledger in any tier. A capped ledger is a
broken ledger: the totals stop being true, every derived number is wrong,
and the app earns one-star reviews for lying rather than for costing
money. This is the single most important product decision in the plan.
The only two counted limits, deliberately few so the rule is memorable.
The import allowance is the conversion moment: a free user proves the
parser works on THEIR bank's statement, with full preview and a working
undo, before paying.

features.$comment: tier: 'free' | 'pro'. clients: where the feature exists today.

sectorPnlBreakdown.why: Analysis, not data. Portfolio value, cost and the allocation donut stay free.

portfolioAnalytics.why: XIRR, benchmark comparison, movers — computed insight.

watchlist.why: Things you do not own — pure convenience.

taxCentre.why: The strongest single justification for the price: STCG/LTCG, realised gains, if-sold-today.

marketsAndNews.why: Network-fetched extras; gating also caps free-tier API cost.

priceRefresh.why: Convenience. Manual price entry stays free so a free portfolio is still correct.

bankStatementImport.why: Work we do for you. One full import free, with undo — see countedAllowances.

autoCapture.why: Android notification-listener capture — the headline automation.

multiProfile.why: Household. First profile free — see countedAllowances.

reportsLongWindow.why: 1Y / YTD / All / custom. The 7D-3M selector stays free.

scoreHistory.why: The current grade and its four pillars stay free — that is the hook.

formattedExports.why: Presentation-grade XLSX / tax-year PDF. The complete encrypted backup and the complete plain CSV are FREE — only filtered, styled output is Pro.

$comment: One product id across all three Apple platforms and Play. Universal
Purchase must be enabled in App Store Connect so one buy covers iPhone,
iPad and Mac; Family Sharing is on because it costs nothing and is a
genuine selling point for a household finance app.
An app-store purchase and a direct licence key are SEPARATE, and the
paywall says so before payment. Linking the two ecosystems needs a
server we do not operate.
